name: AddRecordIdNode
label: Add Record ID
description: Adds a sequential record ID column to a data table, starting at a configurable value with a configurable increment.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to which the record ID column will be added.

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The name of the new record ID column. Defaults to 'RecordID'.

fields.name: StartAt
fields.label: Start At
fields.description: The value of the first record ID. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: Increment
fields.label: Increment
fields.description: The amount to increment each record ID by. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: UpdatedDataTable
fields.label: Updated Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the added record ID column.
